variants.name: Saving
variants.summary: While the save is in flight: the whole fieldset is disabled, Discard is disabled and Save shows its loading state.

variants.name: SaveError
variants.summary: The server rejects the save: Save stops loading, an error toast says the profile was not saved and that the changes are kept, with Retry; the form stays dirty with every entry in place.

variants.name: SavePerGroup
variants.summary: A settings page split into topic groups that each save on their own: a page heading, then one section per topic, each a `SectionHeader` over a flush `Card` of `Item` rows whose footer carries a secondary Save for that group only. Saving one group disables just its own fieldset; the other stays editable. Preferences is the example, with General (Full name, Language) and Notifications (Product updates, Security alerts). Built from `PageHeader`, `SectionHeader`, `SettingsRow`, `Card`, `Item`, `Input`, `Select`, `Switch` and `Button`.

variants.name: SavingOneGroup
variants.summary: General is saving: its Save shows the loading state and its rows are disabled, while Notifications stays editable and can be saved on its own.

variants.name: SavePerCard
variants.summary: A long configuration page split into titled cards that each own their save: a page heading, then one `Card` per topic with an info `Alert`, stacked label-and-control fields inside a fieldset, and a footer whose secondary Save commits that card alone, beside an optional docs `Link`. Project settings is the example, with Preview Toolbar and Deployment Protection. Built from `PageHeader`, `Card`, `Alert`, `Field`, `Select`, `Switch`, `Link` and `Button`.

variants.name: SavingOneCard
variants.summary: Preview Toolbar is saving: its Save shows the loading state and its selects are disabled, while Deployment Protection stays editable.

variants.name: Profile
variants.summary: The profile page of a signed-in account: a small page heading over seven stacked `SettingsSection`s (General, Company information, Address information, Login settings, Source control, Appearance, Danger zone), each a flush `Card` of rows, with the `SaveBar` that rises once a saved field changes. Account name comes filled; Billing emails starts empty and is required; both are checked on Save. Requiring MFA lives in `account/mfa-settings`, linked from the Login settings row; source-control actions open the provider; Delete account asks in a `ConfirmDialog` that takes the account name typed. A save that fails with no field to blame raises an error toast with Retry and keeps the changes.

variants.name: ProfileLoading
variants.summary: The profile's first load: three cards of Skeleton rows in place of the sections, the heading kept.

variants.name: ProfileError
variants.summary: The account did not load: a danger Alert with Retry replaces the profile sections; Retry loads them.
